Run from apps/web: node scripts/mutation-check.mjs ../../docs/fixes/13c-chart-text-minimums.mutants.json; the blind spots in the browser: node scripts/blind-spot-check.mjs ../../docs/fixes/13c-chart-text-minimums.mutants.json

zero-box-redraws.undoes: RC6 — a box of zero (the editor hidden behind Export › Preview poster) keeps the last box: the chart is not redrawn for a box it is not shown in
zero-box-redraws.why: jsdom never reports a box of zero (the test plays the observer); in Chromium the editor hidden behind the preview redraws every chart at the 120 × 90 px floor, and the preview's Print copies it: chart-print-size-check.mjs PRINT

no-wait-for-box.undoes: RC6 — in a laid-out page the chart waits for its box instead of drawing first at the stored size
edits: if (!known && hostRef.current && hostRef.current.offsetWidth > 0 && typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') return;
no-wait-for-box.why: jsdom lays nothing out (offsetWidth is 0), so the wait never applies there; Chromium and Firefox cancel the first draw before it lands, so only WebKit shows it: each chart drawn twice as the editor opens, chart-print-size-check.mjs REDRAW (POSTR_BROWSER=webkit)

measure-no-pad.undoes: round 1 — a canvas width is padded by 2 % and 0.16 em (WebKit's SVG text comes out up to 1.3 % wider than the canvas measures, Firefox's text box 4 px wider)
measure-no-pad.why: jsdom has no canvas; in Firefox labels laid out to the bare advance touch the chart's edges and each other: chart-print-size-check.mjs CLIP or COLLIDE

measure-scaled.undoes: round 1 — text is measured at the size it is drawn at, not at 100 px and scaled (the system font spaces small text wider: 3 to 4 % short at 25 px)
edits:
ctx.font = `${fontPx}px ${fontFamily}`;
      w = ctx.measureText(text).width * PAD_RATIO + PAD_EM * fontPx;

ctx.font = `100px ${fontFamily}`;
      w = (ctx.measureText(text).width / 100) * fontPx * PAD_RATIO + PAD_EM * fontPx;
measure-scaled.why: jsdom has no canvas, so no test runs this line
measure-scaled.unguarded: MEASURED, equivalent for the gates: with the 2 % and 0.16 em pad, a measurer that scales from 100 px holds every claim on the partitions (chart-print-size-check.mjs --only paste in Firefox; --only paste-sides,paste-longcap,quick in Chromium and Firefox: exit 0 under this mutant). Measuring at the drawn size is kept for accuracy, not because a gate needs it: the scaling error grows as text shrinks (6.7 % short for a long title at 19.4 px in Chromium, scratch probe ffmeasure), and the pad is sized for the engines' differences, not for it.

print-headroom-off.undoes: round 1 — the chart's floor sits 0.5 % above the minimums, so the print's rounding of a box laid out to the chart's least height cannot take its text below them
